top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs base editing (Liu) with reversible-terminator sequencing by synthesis (Balasubramanian, Klenerman): both are mature, reproduced chemistry acting directly on DNA bases that changed what researchers and clinicians can do, with citations naming a specific chemical step and clean attribution on each part. P002 is the safer base-editing-only fallback with a wider but defensible credit; P004 is chemically sound but Pd C-N coupling extends an already honoured area.
